_readme: 4 ROI definitions for Himalaya Winter Defense 50ml NSC label inspection.
Full images: RGB BMP 1504x8000. Crops: grayscale PNGs saved by crop_roi.py.
h/w = approximate reference dimensions from sample crops (1.bmp–4.bmp).
Template matching finds each ROI independently using patch_roi*.png files.
Only the COMPLETE (uncut) occurrence per image is used for training.
The '3 Way Care' graphic (ROI_4) and logo (ROI_1) each appear twice—pick the complete one.

ROI_1._note: Himalaya logo + SINCE 1930 + Winter Defense Moisturizing Cream + wellness seal

ROI_2._note: Jojoba Oil · Wheat Germ · Almond Oil text + ingredient description paragraph

ROI_3._note: Address + regulatory text + MFG/EXP dates + barcode + Net Vol. 50ml

ROI_4._note: 3 Way Care graphic — Jojoba Oil / Wheat Germ / Almond Oil icons with captions
